title: UAAP: Adamson women hold off Ateneo, earn share of second
summary: Adamson University held off Ateneo de Manila University, 79-70, for its fourth straight win in the UAAP Season 89 women's basketball tournament, late Wednesday at the Mall of Asia Arena.
